class: A value that carries its own data health inside the domain (a forward from a stale spot, a level from a delayed quote) loses that health when it is turned into the API response, so the screen shows a number built from stale data as if it were current - often next to other values that do say stale.
mechanism: backend/ofo/marketdata/forward.py parity_forward accepts a STALE or DELAYED spot by design and records `spot_health`; backend/ofo_app/routes/leg_picker.py:472-494 (`_forward`) and `ForwardOut` had no field for it, so LegPicker.vue showed "Forward used for pricing: 22557.59 (estimated from spot)" from a 20-minute-old spot while the futures beside it said FEED_STALE.

first_seen.where: chunk 2 Tier A review, area C (Opus), on build/seq-chunk-2 7f86296a; row 19 built the futures tab
first_seen.evidence: review-c/probe_forward.py: a STALE NIFTY spot (22533.25, 20 min old) -> {'forward': '22557.59', 'source': 'spot_fallback', 'label': 'estimated from spot', 'reason': None}; grep of tests_app/test_leg_picker*.py for forward + stale/health/delayed: 0 lines.

fix: Instance: ForwardOut carries the spot health and the screen shows it. Class: every domain object with a health field reaching a response is listed per route with carried / dropped (fix round on build/seq-chunk2-rev-c).

detection.note: Becomes guarded for the forward row when its stale/delayed route tests merge. Not covered: a new response model that drops a health field - a repo test comparing domain dataclasses' health fields with their response models would close it.

occurrences.where: chunk 2 Tier A review area C
